title: Environmental Economics
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a shield that protects life on earth from the hostile conditions from the outer spheres."
The atmosphere is a shield that protects life on earth from the hostile conditions from the outer spheres.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum of all the quantities of a good or serviced per period by each by ach firm at the various prices."
Market Supply is the sum of all the quantities of a good or serviced per period by each by ach firm at the various prices.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of science that systematically studies the relationships between living organisms and the physical and chemical environment in which they live."
Ecology is a branch of science that systematically studies the relationships between living organisms and the physical and chemical environment in which they live.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the satisfaction derived from the consumption of one more extra unit of the commodity."
Marginal utility is the satisfaction derived from the consumption of one more extra unit of the commodity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to movement along a demand curve as a result of changes in the price of the commodity."
Change in quantity demanded refers to movement along a demand curve as a result of changes in the price of the commodity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the quantity of a commodity sellers wish to sell at each conceivable price."
Supply is the quantity of a commodity sellers wish to sell at each conceivable price.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the sum of individually demanded quantities at the various prices."
Market demand is the sum of individually demanded quantities at the various prices.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the quantity of a commodity buyer wish to purchase at each conceivable price."
Demand is the quantity of a commodity buyer wish to purchase at each conceivable price.

Households

Supply curves

Supply Schedule is a table showing how much of a given commodity a seller would be willing to sell different prices.

environment
The environment is the supplier of all forms of resources.

biological environment

Water

social environment
